queries.text: The original spells the researcher’s name "Johnasson" (also in chapter 22); corrected to Peter K. Jonason. "Tríade sinistra" (literally "sinister triad") rendered with the established English term "Dark Triad" (narcissism, Machiavellianism, psychopathy); alternative: "sinister triad".
"matrimônio perfeito" alludes to Samael Aun Weor’s "The Perfect Matrimony" (O Matrimônio Perfeito), the title used in The Profane Feminine; rendered "the perfect matrimony."
